corrections.why: the hand-checked table's 100 years is the projected maximum of Voituron et al., Biology Letters 7:105, 2011 (about 102 years), and its 68 is their mean adult lifespan in a laboratory population; neither is an observed maximum, so the species takes its lifespan from the next source in precedence that records one
AnAge's 102 years is the same projection (Voituron et al. 2011), not an observed age
the hand-checked table's 25 g cites no source; AnAge and Amniote both give 8.73 g
